clips.title: The story
paras: Talonbranch Glade is a quiet night elf redoubt nestled in the blighted hills of northern Felwood. Located just south of Timbermaw Hold, it provides a rare haven of pristine moonlight, sanctuary, and hippogryph transit in an otherwise corrupted wilderness.

Perched on high ground near the tunnel to Timbermaw Hold, Talonbranch Glade serves as the northernmost bastion of the Alliance in Felwood. Centered around a sheltered night elf lodge and a functioning moonwell, the outpost offers a crucial refuge from the demonic corruption that has swallowed the surrounding forest. Alliance scouts, Sentinels, and passing adventurers use the glade to rest, recover, and plan their excursions deeper into the tainted woods or onward toward Winterspring and Moonglade.

Aside from its natural and spiritual defenses, Talonbranch Glade functions as an essential logistics hub. Hippogryphs stationed here connect travelers to Auberdine in Darkshore and Everlook in the snowy expanse beyond Timbermaw Hold. It remains a lonely, vigilant watchpost holding the line against the encroaching shadows of the Shadow Council and feral beast packs roaming the corrupted vales.
